items.guidance: In a Go build, the commit string is typically injected via -ldflags -X into a version variable; if the Dockerfile or a Makefile target derives it with git rev-parse, pass the build argument value into that -ldflags flag instead. Keep the same variable target so the app's version output still works, just with the default value when no argument is given.

pgweb is a database client UI on port 8081, so check its router for an existing lightweight route that answers without a database connection (for example a static asset or a status/info endpoint) and confirm it returns 2xx with no active connection. If you add a route, register it on the same router before any basic-auth or session middleware.

pgweb is a database browser that connects to user-supplied databases, so it likely owns no schema of its own. Check the repository for migration files, golang-migrate or goose usage, or schema creation at startup, and if none exist report that no migration command is needed. The package.json evidence does not apply to a Go app.
